import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot 1: Count plot of transaction types with fraud detection
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=ax[0])
ax[0].set_title('Transaction Type by Fraud Status')
ax[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax[0].set_ylabel('Count')
ax[0].legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Plot 2: Boxplot of transaction amounts by hour, colored by fraud status
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', ax=ax[1])
ax[1].set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour and Fraud Status')
ax[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax[1].set_ylabel('Transaction Amount')
ax[1].legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=ax[0])

ax[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax[0].set_ylabel('Count')
